en.title: Account Types on Archeris
en.excerpt: A friendly guide explaining the three user roles on Archeris: Tournament Organizers, Archers, and Field Scorekeepers.
en.content:
1. Welcome to Archeris

Archeris is designed to make archery events simple, fair, and fun for everyone. To give you the best experience, the platform has three different types of accounts based on how you participate in archery:

  • Tournament Organizers: People and clubs who plan and run competitions.
  • Archers (Athletes): Archers who register, compete, and track their scores and certificates.
  • Field Scorekeepers: Volunteers and line judges who enter arrow scores right at the target.

2. Tournament Organizer

An Organizer Account is made for archery clubs, event committees, and organizations that host competitions. When you log in as an organizer, you get tools to manage your entire tournament from start to finish:

  • Create & Publish Events: Set your tournament name, venue, dates, age categories (like U-12, U-15, Senior), and registration fees.
  • Manage Registrations: View registered participants, approve payments, and download athlete rosters.
  • Target Line Assignments: Assign archers to target butts (Target 1A, 1B, 2A, etc.) easily.
  • Automatic Match Brackets: Let the system automatically generate elimination tournament brackets based on qualification rankings.
  • Live Leaderboard & Scorekeepers: Create quick 5-character scoring codes for field volunteers so scores update in real-time.

3. Archer (Athlete)

An Archer Account is your personal archery passport. It is perfect for individual archers, parents registering their children, or club managers:

  • Personal Profile: Save your name, club name, gender, birth date, and bow type (Recurve, Compound, Barebow, or Traditional).
  • Quick Tournament Sign-Up: Register for events in just a few clicks. Your saved profile automatically fills in your registration details so you never have to re-enter them.
  • Live Match & Target Info: Check your target assignment, qualification schedule, and bracket matches directly from your phone.
  • Official E-Certificates: View and download your verified competition certificates whenever you need them.

4. Field Scorekeeper

A Scorekeeper is a field official or volunteer who inputs arrow scores next to the target butts during a match. We made this as simple as possible so anyone can help score:

  • No Password Needed: Volunteers do not need to register with an email or create a password.
  • 5-Character Access Code: The tournament organizer gives you a simple 5-character code (such as SK123) for your target.
  • Easy Phone Scoring: Open the scorekeeper page on your mobile browser, enter your code, and tap the big score buttons (X, 10, 9, 8...) after each end.
  • Instant Live Updates: As soon as you save the scores, the main event leaderboard and public screens update immediately.

5. Quick Role Comparison

What you want to do Organizer Archer Scorekeeper
Host a tournament and set up categories Yes No No
Sign up and compete in tournaments No Yes No
Input arrow scores at the target line Yes No Yes (via code)
Download event results and certificates Yes Yes No

6. Frequently Asked Questions

Can I be both an Organizer and an Archer?
Yes! Many archers also run their own club events. You can register an Organizer account for your club and an Archer account for your personal competitions using separate emails.

Do volunteers need to create accounts to score?
No. Scorekeepers only need a mobile phone and the 5-character event code provided by the organizer.

Is an Archer account free?
Yes, creating an Archer account and maintaining your athlete profile is completely free.
